name: Adaptive Sampling via Per-Fragment Clipping
definition: A technique to avoid aliasing in volume rendering by clipping tetrahedral cells on the graphics card using up to two parallel planes, rather than geometrically splitting cells or using pre-integration. It allows for gradient-based opacity and multidimensional transfer functions.
summary: Adaptive Sampling via Per-Fragment Clipping avoids aliasing in volume rendering by clipping tetrahedral cells on the GPU using parallel planes, enabling gradient-based and multidimensional transfer functions.
